question: Shyam starts from Point A and drives 12 km towards east. He then takes a right turn, drives 7 km, turns right and drives 5 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 9 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 7 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given: 

Shyam starts from Point A and drives 12 km towards east.

He then takes a right turn, drives 7 km, turns right and drives 5 km.

He then takes a left turn and drives 9 km.

He takes a final right turn, drives 7 km and stops at Point P. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1917ef29fc5c06c3a464837216ba6cb2dad05295c681c0214d3ec28c1bd0aa88.png] 

So, He should drive **16 km towards north **in order to reach Point A again

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
